# Splitting into Gauges + Cleaning 
```{r}
#
daily_data <- read.csv("usgs_daily_combined.csv")

red_bluff <- daily_data %>%
  filter(monitoring_location_id == "USGS-11377100") |>
  mutate(discharge_m3s = value * 0.0283168) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(time)) |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))) |>
  select(monitoring_location_id, discharge_m3s, date, year) 

colusa <- daily_data %>%
  filter(monitoring_location_id == "USGS-11389500") |>
  mutate(discharge_m3s = value * 0.0283168) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(time)) |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))) |>
  select(monitoring_location_id, discharge_m3s, date, year) 

```

# Compute Z-Score

## Red Bluff 
### Compute Thresholds 

```{r}

#Compute Thresholds 

#95th Percentile and Mean
red_bluff_z <- red_bluff %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    p95_q  = quantile(discharge_m3s, 0.95),
    mean_q = mean(discharge_m3s),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Flood Duration 
p90_thr <- quantile(red_bluff$discharge_m3s, 0.90)

flood_dur <- red_bluff %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(flood_dur = sum(discharge_m3s > p90_thr), .groups = "drop")

red_bluff_z <- red_bluff_z %>% left_join(flood_dur, by = "year")

```

### Build Long-Term Baseline Stats 

```{r}
metrics   <- c("p95_q", "mean_q", "flood_dur")
log_shift <- c(0,        0,         1)

baseline <- list()
for (i in seq_along(metrics)) {
  m     <- metrics[i]
  shift <- log_shift[i]
  vals  <- annual[[m]]
  safe_vals <- ifelse(vals + shift > 0, vals + shift, NA_real_)
  lv <- log(safe_vals)
  baseline[[m]] <- list(
    mu  = mean(vals),
    sd  = sd(vals),
    lmu = mean(lv),
    lsd = sd(lv)
  )
}
```

### Compute Z-Score by Year 

```{r}
for (i in seq_along(metrics)) {
  m     <- metrics[i]
  shift <- log_shift[i]
  b <- baseline[[m]]

  annual[[paste0("z_", m)]] <-
    if (!is.na(b$sd) && b$sd > 0) (annual[[m]] - b$mu) / b$sd else NA_real_

  annual[[paste0("zlog_", m)]] <-
    if (!is.na(b$lsd) && b$lsd > 0) (log(annual[[m]] + shift) - b$lmu) / b$lsd else NA_real_
}

```
